mx-brio.name: Logitech MX Brio 4K Webcam
mx-brio.why: 4K webcam with a real sensor upgrade over the old Brio. Sharp, well-priced, plug and play.

facecam-4k.name: Elgato Facecam 4K
facecam-4k.why: 4K60 over USB-C. Locks exposure (no creep), pairs cleanly with Stream Deck.

facecam-pro.name: Elgato Facecam Pro
facecam-pro.why: Sony STARVIS sensor, low-light upgrade over Brio/Facecam.

obsbot-tiny2.name: OBSBOT Tiny 2 (auto-track)
obsbot-tiny2.why: AI auto-track keeps you centered when you move. Great for solo shooters.

zve10-ii.name: Sony ZV-E10 II (body)
zve10-ii.why: APS-C mirrorless with USB streaming, RTMP/SRT support. The default $5k camera.

zve10-ii-kit.name: Sony ZV-E10 II (kit 16-50 II)
zve10-ii-kit.why: Same body, includes the new power-zoom kit lens. Good starting point.

canon-r50v.name: Canon R50 V
canon-r50v.why: Canon's vlog-first R50 variant. Clean USB streaming.

fuji-xs20.name: Fujifilm X-S20
fuji-xs20.why: Best film simulations in the category. Strong stills + video crossover.

bmd-studio.name: Blackmagic Studio Camera 4K Plus G2
bmd-studio.why: Designed for the ATEM ecosystem. Tally, talkback, PoE on a single cable.

sony-fx30.name: Sony FX30 (Cinema Line APS-C)
sony-fx30.why: Cinema-line ergonomics, dual base ISO. The serious "recording" pick.

birddog-p200.name: BirdDog P200 PTZ
birddog-p200.why: 1080p60 full NDI PTZ. SDI+HDMI+NDI simultaneous out. Core of the NDI route.

birddog-p400.name: BirdDog P400 4K PTZ
birddog-p400.why: First 4K NDI camera with 4:2:2 hardware decode. PoE+. The premium NDI route.

sigma-16-14.name: Sigma 16mm f/1.4 (E-mount)
sigma-16-14.why: Fast wide prime — flattering for talking head, great in low light.

sigma-30-14.name: Sigma 30mm f/1.4 (E-mount)
sigma-30-14.why: Closer to "natural" focal length than 16mm, still fast.

tamron-17-70.name: Tamron 17-70mm f/2.8 (E-mount)
tamron-17-70.why: Single zoom that covers wide-to-tight. Lower lens-swap overhead during live work.

samson-q2u.name: Samson Q2U
samson-q2u.why: Cheapest legit hybrid USB/XLR dynamic. Outperforms any condenser at this price.

podmic-usb.name: RODE PodMic USB
podmic-usb.why: Tuned for spoken word, internal shock mount, USB/XLR hybrid. The 2026 default starter mic.

mv7-plus.name: Shure MV7+
mv7-plus.why: Hybrid USB/XLR. Auto-level mode, app DSP, dynamic capsule rejects room noise. Upgrade path without replacing the mic.

sm7b.name: Shure SM7B
sm7b.why: Broadcast standard XLR. Requires interface + clean preamp. A forever mic.

sm7db.name: Shure SM7dB
sm7db.why: SM7B with built-in preamp. Removes the Cloudlifter requirement.

countryman-h6.name: Countryman H6 headset
countryman-h6.why: Hands-free panelist mic. Tiny, broadcast-quality, hands-free.

dji-mic-2.name: DJI Mic 2 (kit)
dji-mic-2.why: Wireless lav. 32-bit float internal recording = backup audio insurance.

rode-wireless.name: RODE Wireless Pro
rode-wireless.why: On-board 32-bit float + timecode. Trade for DJI Mic 2 based on platform preference.

scarlett-2i2.name: Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 (4th gen)
scarlett-2i2.why: The reference cheap interface. Two XLR inputs, AIR mode, USB-C.

flow8.name: Behringer Flow 8
flow8.why: Eight-channel digital mixer with Bluetooth app control. Punches above its weight.

rcv-duo.name: RØDECaster Duo
rcv-duo.why: Mini RØDECaster with same DSP. Right size for a 2-host podcast.

x32-rack.name: Behringer X32 Rack
x32-rack.why: 40-channel digital mixer in 3U. Routes to Dante, USB, network. Broadcast-grade.

mdr-7506.name: Sony MDR-7506 headphones
mdr-7506.why: Industry default closed-back. Boring, accurate, indestructible.

iem-sidekick.name: Behringer P1 IEM ("Sidekick")
iem-sidekick.why: In-ear monitor for hosts who hate cans on camera.

halo-60x.name: Aputure Amaran Halo 60x
halo-60x.why: New 2026 Halo series — bicolor COB, Bowens mount, app control. Best $/W in the line.

halo-100x.name: Aputure Amaran Halo 100x
halo-100x.why: Bigger Halo COB. Add a softbox and you have a real key light.

amaran-200x.name: Aputure Amaran 200x S
amaran-200x.why: Real cinema-style bicolor COB. Pair with parabolic softbox for portrait-grade key.

aputure-300d.name: Aputure LS 300d III
aputure-300d.why: Daylight 300W cinema light. The "feels expensive on camera" tier.

aputure-mc.name: Aputure MC RGB pocket light
aputure-mc.why: Magnet-mountable RGB accent. Use to break up the backdrop.

elgato-key.name: Elgato Key Light Air
elgato-key.why: App-controlled flat panel. Lower output than COB but simpler form factor.

light-stands.name: Light stands (pair, 7ft)
light-stands.why: You will buy these. Might as well budget for them.

boom-stands.name: Manfrotto boom stands (pair)
boom-stands.why: Real boom arms keep lights out of frame from above. Worth the upgrade.

autopole.name: Manfrotto Autopole kit (2x)
autopole.why: Floor-to-ceiling pole rig. Cleanest way to mount lights without taking floor space.

softbox.name: Bowens softbox (octa, 36in)
softbox.why: Soft, controlled key. Cheap upgrade with disproportionate visual payoff.

softbox-pro.name: Parabolic softbox 5ft (Bowens)
softbox-pro.why: Big light source = soft, flattering. The "looks like a pro lit it" upgrade.

obs-free.name: OBS Studio (free)
obs-free.why: Free, open source. The default starting point. Capture cards plug in here.

ecamm.name: Ecamm Live (Mac)
ecamm.why: Mac-only multi-cam streaming. Easier than OBS for non-engineers.

vmix-basic.name: vMix Basic HD (annual)
vmix-basic.why: Entry-level vMix. Limit on inputs but full feature set otherwise.

vmix-hd.name: vMix HD (perpetual)
vmix-hd.why: Owns it forever. Right call if you stream weekly.

vmix-4k.name: vMix 4K (perpetual)
vmix-4k.why: 4K capable, more inputs. The NDI-route default.

vmix-pro.name: vMix Pro
vmix-pro.why: 8 NDI inputs, instant replay, scoreboard, full broadcast feature set.

atem-mini.name: ATEM Mini Pro
atem-mini.why: Hardware switcher with streaming engine. No PC required for basic streams.

rcv-core.name: RØDECaster Video Core
rcv-core.why: All-in-one switcher + audio mixer (software-based scenes). Simplest live $5k path.

rcv-full.name: RØDECaster Video (full)
rcv-full.why: 6 video inputs (4 HDMI + 2 USB), 9 audio channels, scenes, ISO recording, auto-switch by speaker.

atem-extreme.name: ATEM Mini Extreme ISO G2
atem-extreme.why: New G2. ISO recording per input, hardware buttons. The right pick for $10–20k.

atem-tv-studio.name: ATEM Television Studio HD8 ISO
atem-tv-studio.why: Real broadcast switcher form factor. SDI throughout. The Blackmagic-route hub.

m4250.name: NETGEAR M4250 AV-over-IP switch
m4250.why: NDI/Dante/AVB-friendly managed switch. Required for the NDI route.

mac-mini-m4.name: Mac mini M4 (16GB)
mac-mini-m4.why: M4 is overkill for most encoding. 16GB base is fine for OBS/Ecamm.

mac-mini-pro.name: Mac mini M4 Pro (24GB)
mac-mini-pro.why: Headroom for multi-cam vMix or heavy ISO recording.

beelink-pc.name: Beelink mini PC (Ryzen, 16GB)
beelink-pc.why: Cheaper than a Mac mini. Good if you already live in Windows.

pc-rtx.name: PC w/ RTX 4070 (32GB)
pc-rtx.why: Required for vMix at 4K with NDI workloads. NVENC offloads encoding.

pc-rtx-pro.name: PC w/ RTX 4080 (64GB)
pc-rtx-pro.why: For multi-NDI/4K and instant replay. The "I want to ignore the CPU forever" build.

dell-43-4k.name: Dell 43" 4K monitor
dell-43-4k.why: Quad-up: program, preview, audio meters, source feeds — all visible at once.

usb-capture.name: Elgato HD60 X capture card
usb-capture.why: Gets mirrorless HDMI clean into OBS as a webcam.

cam-link-4k.name: Elgato Cam Link 4K
cam-link-4k.why: Cheaper than HD60 X if you don't need passthrough.

hyperdeck-shut.name: Blackmagic HyperDeck Shuttle 4K Pro
hyperdeck-shut.why: Dedicated recorder, removes the "what if OBS crashes" risk.

hyperdeck-std.name: Blackmagic HyperDeck Studio HD Plus
hyperdeck-std.why: Rack-mount recorder. Pairs naturally with the ATEM workflow.

ssd-1tb.name: Samsung T7 1TB SSD
ssd-1tb.why: External SSD for project files. T7 is the boring-reliable choice.

ssd-2tb.name: Samsung T9 2TB SSD
ssd-2tb.why: Faster than T7, double the capacity. For ISO recording workflows.

sd-card.name: 128GB V60 SD card
sd-card.why: Don't cheap out on cards. V60 minimum for the ZV-E10 II.

boom-arm.name: RODE PSA1+ boom arm
boom-arm.why: No clunk, broad reach, no creep. The boom arm everyone ends up buying.

cables-basic.name: Cables kit (USB, HDMI, XLR)
cables-basic.why: Don't forget the cables. Every build hits this realization at checkout.

cables-pro.name: Cables kit (XLR x4, HDMI x4, USB-C x2)
cables-pro.why: Multi-cam means multi-cables. Budget for it up front.

cables-bcast.name: Cables kit (XLR, HDMI, Ethernet, power)
cables-bcast.why: Including Cat6A runs. Cleaner install, fewer surprises.

ups-1500.name: CyberPower 1500VA UPS
ups-1500.why: The "boring" item that saves your live show when the power flickers.

ups-3000.name: APC Smart-UPS 3000VA
ups-3000.why: Pro-level UPS with network monitoring. Backs up the whole rack.

tripod.name: Manfrotto compact tripod
tripod.why: Mirrorless on a hot mess of a table mount looks like a hot mess on camera.

tripod-pro.name: Benro pro video tripod
tripod-pro.why: Fluid head matters for pan/tilt during live work.

parrot-prompt.name: Parrot Teleprompter 2
parrot-prompt.why: Tablet-based prompter. Fine for short scripts, not panel work.

prompt-24.name: Prompter People 24" teleprompter
prompt-24.why: Real broadcast prompter. Hosts can read without breaking eye contact.

backdrop.name: Westcott X-Drop backdrop
backdrop.why: Drop-down backdrop. Sets up in 60 seconds.

acoustic-pan.name: Acoustic panels (8x 2ft)
acoustic-pan.why: Treat the room before chasing a better mic.

confidence.name: Confidence monitor (24" HDMI)
confidence.why: Lets the host see the program feed. Required for paid live work.

ptz12x.name: PTZOptics 12X-NDI
ptz12x.why: 12x optical zoom, full NDI|3, PoE+. The workhorse PTZ for hybrid rooms.

ptz20x.name: PTZOptics 20X-NDI
ptz20x.why: 20x zoom reaches the back row. IP control + NDI. The teleconference standard.

ptz30x.name: PTZOptics 30X-NDI
ptz30x.why: 30x zoom, 4K60. For auditoriums and large spaces.

stream-deck-mini.name: Elgato Stream Deck Mini
stream-deck-mini.why: 6 keys. Enough for scene switching without the full Stream Deck commitment.

stream-deck-xl.name: Elgato Stream Deck XL
stream-deck-xl.why: 32 keys. For complex multi-camera shows with macros.

stream-deck-plus.name: Elgato Stream Deck Plus
stream-deck-plus.why: 8 keys + 4 knobs. Audio mixing meets scene control.

ndi-decode.name: BirdDog Flex 4K NDI Decoder
ndi-decode.why: Converts NDI back to HDMI/SDI. Required for confidence monitors in NDI workflows.

ndi-encode.name: Magewell Ultra Encode HDMI
ndi-encode.why: Turns any HDMI source into NDI. The Swiss Army knife of NDI routing.
